verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships versioned npm packages (@babylonjs/core at 9.26.1), and community users repeatedly praise its strong backwards compatibility compared with Three.js. However, the pack contains no first-party documentation of a deprecation policy or of the versioning and compatibility guarantees an agent could rely on. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, documented semver or compatibility guarantees, and changelog/migration docs with deprecation notices.
